must_identify.item: Pods are in ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull because the tag nginx:1.27-alpne does not exist
must_identify.evidence: Error: The Docker image "nginx:1.27-alpne" cannot be found because of a typo in the tag name.

must_identify.item: The old pods are still serving (rollout stuck, not an outage)

notes: The RCA never mentions the old ReplicaSet still serving. Its second finding implies the Service has no working endpoints and blames a readiness probe or app issue, which misreads a stuck rollout as an outage. A reviewer should also check whether the user's deployment YAML is the source of truth, since the change was made with kubectl set image, so 'update YAML and apply' may not match how the tag was set.
